key_insight: Mixed compliance demonstrations are not interchangeable: benign examples can either suppress or amplify harmful compliance depending on the model, ordering, and training stage.
engineering_relevance: For safety-aligned LLMs, robust behavior depends not just on refusal tuning but on how in-context examples are composed and ordered during deployment.
method: Mixed benign and harmful compliance demonstrations in prompts
Tested four LLMs across different demonstration compositions and ordering
Compared effects across training stages, especially preference optimization
evidence_signal: The abstract reports cross-model evaluation showing distinct harmful-compliance responses to benign vs. harmful demonstrations, with strong recency effects and refusal-format differences.
watch_item: Prompt behavior can shift sharply with demonstration order and model training, so safety testing should include mixed-example and refusal-format stress cases before deployment.
paper_title: What Do Safety-Aligned LLMs Learn From Mixed Compliance Demonstrations?
